FINAL CUTOVER — COMPLETE IVX INDEPENDENCE NOW

The source recovery is accepted as partially complete, but production independence is not complete.

Execute all actions you can perform automatically and give the owner exact click-by-click instructions only for actions requiring owner account access.

1. Confirm recovery/clean-source contains the complete usable source.
2. Confirm tracked file count and zero gitlinks/submodules.
3. Prepare the exact safe branch cutover:
   - archive broken main as main-broken-archive
   - make recovery/clean-source the default branch
   - rename recovery/clean-source to main
4. Do not delete the broken branch until final verification.
5. After owner branch cutover, detect the new main automatically.
6. Trigger all GitHub Actions workflows.
7. Rebind Render to the new main branch.
8. Clear Render build cache and deploy.
9. Verify GitHub SHA = Render SHA = runtime /health SHA.
10. Build a new signed Android APK through GitHub Actions.
11. Publish the APK to an owner-controlled permanent location.
12. Return APK filename, version, versionCode, source SHA, and SHA-256.
13. Generate a real-device QA checklist for the owner.
14. Verify the backup archive exists and provide upload instructions.
15. Run the final Rork dependency scan.
16. Do not mark complete until Rork runtime dependency count is zero.

Every 2 hours, post the progress report inside IVX IA Chat with:
- completed actions
- blocked owner actions
- current GitHub SHA
- current Render SHA
- current runtime SHA
- APK build status
- remaining Rork dependency count
- next actions

Final acceptance:
- complete source on owner GitHub main
- fresh clone works
- Render deploys from owner GitHub
- production SHA parity
- APK built from same SHA
- owner credentials rotated
- backup stored outside Rork
- zero active Rork dependencies
